x: John found himself up against his Surrey County victor Ford(Aldershot F.D.) and Julian Goater (Shaftesbury) who is coached by the man who took Dave Bedford through to the Senior ranks.
My term ended in May this year after the Varsity match. Julian Goater is the present President.

Bernie Ford (Aldershot, Farnham & Dist) was the winner in 29:09 with Gerard 11 seconds down in 2nd place but comfortably ahead of John Wild (Camb & Col), Jos Hermans (Netherlands), Danny McDaid (Tirconal), the Tuck Twins (Camb & Col), and Julian Goater and Dave Bedford (both Shaftesbury).
Short Stages: 1.S.Coe (Har) 15.07; 2.J.Goater (Shafts) 15.17; 3.A.Pettigrew (WSE) 15.18. Long Stages: 1.E.Martin (Bas) 24.00; 2.= M.O'Reilly (Highgate) 24.22; G.Payne (Southend) 24.22.
Julian Goater (Shafts) finished 5th in AFD colours while Omega had drafted in two top Welsh runners. Its about time this league was restricted to bona fide clubmen.

Returning to the famous course for the first time since Julian Goater won by nearly two minutes in 1981, and although the strength of the fields was perhaps weakened by the revamped Inter-Counties/ International Trial three weeks before, the National nevertheless produced three very exciting races.
Gary broke the record held since 1977 by Julian Goater by six seconds in spite of pulling a calf muscle in the final 200 yards of the third leg and limping home.
